title: The Hill Path
story:
Mara and her brother Luis wanted a quiet walk before lunch. They left the village and followed a dirt track toward the green hills. The morning was cool, and the grass was wet. Mara carried water, and Luis carried a small map. After twenty minutes, the track became a narrow hill path. Loose stones rolled under their shoes, so they walked slowly. Luis stopped and pointed at a wooden sign by a low fence. The paint was old, but the words were still easy to read. The sign said the path was safe if people stayed on it.

They held the fence when the ground dropped away beside them. Far below, a river shone in the sun. A bird called, and the sound bounced between the rocks. Halfway up, they found a flat rock and sat down. Mara shared an apple, and Luis looked at the map again. He smiled because the top was closer than he had expected.

They stood up, and the wind grew stronger. Near the top, the path turned behind a large bush. Then the hill opened, and the view became wide and clear. Fields, roofs, and the river lay below them. They took a photo and wrote the time in a notebook. The walk down was easier, but they watched their feet. At the sign, Mara touched the wood and thanked Luis for the map. They reached home in time for lunch.
